audience: businesses that track staff time and attendance in TimeStation

useCases.title: See who is clocked in and in which department
useCases.text: List the employees with their current in or out status and department. Open one employee to read the details.

useCases.title: Review an employee's shifts for a period
useCases.text: List the shifts of one employee within a date range, with check-in, check-out and total minutes. Open one shift to read its details.

useCases.title: Run an attendance report for a date range
useCases.text: Run a TimeStation report such as AttendanceOnly for a date range. The report comes back as CSV with a header row.

useCases.title: Add a new employee to a department
useCases.text: Create an employee record and assign a department by its ID or name. A new department is created when the name is not known.

useCases.title: Check out an employee or close an open shift
useCases.text: Check out an employee at a set time, or close one open shift by its ID. Read the shift first to confirm which one is open.
